title: PI objectives — tranche 8 (retrospective, 2026-11-28)
body:
# PI objectives — tranche 8

## Objectives

- O1 — S06d is accepted: one connector class for web, Telegram and MCP, with its Phase-G review and closure complete.
- O2 — S13 is accepted: the process engine stands and its reusable workflow catalogue is shipped (or its built claim withdrawn), with `v1-s13-1` resolved and the project re-closed.
- O3 — S19 is accepted and stays active: eval rows carry signed-off cases, a held-out wall and an audit, and its declared outputs are published.
- O4 — the tranche-8 exit gate is green on three fresh receipts at one snapshot sha and hands the tranche to #755's review.

## Business value

O1 removes bespoke per-channel integration and gives one inbound decision row per interaction (`B5` one model, `B1` auditable decisions). O2 closes the gap between "built" and shipped — a claim the catalogue supports (`B6` predictable delivery). O3 makes the acceptance bar's evidence a signed, audited row rather than a file (`B1`). O4 gives the review a tranche it can decide on without re-measuring.

## Measurement

Each objective is measured by its member's receipt: `verify-project.py` verdict `green` at the pinned snapshot, with S06d and S13 re-closed through their closure gates and S19 still `active`. S13 additionally measures on the ledger: `v1-s13-1` carries `resolved_by` with a commit, test and evidence. O4 measures on `check-tranche-exit.py --tranche 8` exiting 0 at the same snapshot sha and writing `tranche-exit.json`.

## Evidence

The acceptance manifests `acceptance/programme/{S06d,S13,S19}.toml`, the three receipts under `docs/evidence/rework/`, `docs/evidence/rework/tranche-8/tranche-exit.json`, the ledger in `docs/evidence/v1-conformance-findings.json`, and the pinned snapshot recorded in `cadences.json`.
